title: Pigpen ports list
description: The dispatch list for every Pigpen port. One row per port or move. scripts/ports.mjs validates it (npm run quality) and generates ports/README.md from it (npm run generate).

upstream.description: One upstream repository, pinned to a full commit. author is the person or organisation that wrote it.

path.description: Where the ported source lives inside the upstream repository (a monorepo package, an app directory).

id.description: The argument of the porting Skill: `port row <id>`.

kind.description: port: translation of an upstream program. adapter: original code built on an upstream SDK or protocol. move: existing code moved in from another repository. original: new code (an upstream asset may still be credited).

upstream.description: The primary upstream. Required unless kind is original.

additionalUpstreams.description: Further pinned upstreams (a protocol schema, a second source).

targetPackage.description: The Package the port ships as: components/<name> (or piglets/<name>).

otherTargets.description: Other directories this row owns (a Piglet, a shared library).

lane.description: The port lane. For a queued row, the name the lane will take.

priority.description: Queue order for queued rows (1 is next).

credit.description: The credit text shipped in CREDITS.md. Names the upstream, its URL and its author.
